component.name: Dialog
component.description: Modal dialog with header, body, and footer slots, backdrop overlay, and dismissal control.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Element users activate to open the dialog.

slots.name: overlay
slots.description: Backdrop layer rendered behind the dialog panel.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Dialog panel containing header, body, footer, and close control.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Top region for dialog title and description.

slots.name: wrapper
slots.description: Inner card wrapper that arranges dialog header, body, and footer.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Supporting text associated with the dialog title.

own.name: body
own.description: Custom element to render in the body slot.

own.name: children
own.description: Content to render inside the dialog trigger slot.

own.name: close
own.description: Whether to show a close button.

own.name: closeIcon
own.type: string | number | boolean | Node | JSX.ArrayElement | (string & {}) | Component<Omit<IconProps, "name">> | null | undefined
own.description: Icon name or custom content for the close button.

own.name: description
own.description: Secondary description displayed below the title.

own.name: dismissible
own.description: Whether outside interaction and Escape should dismiss the shell.

own.name: footer
own.description: Custom element to render in the footer slot.

own.name: fullscreen
own.description: Whether the dialog should take up the full viewport.

own.name: header
own.description: Custom element to render in the header slot.

own.name: id
own.description: Unique identifier used to derive the content id.

own.name: onClosePrevent
own.description: Called when a dismissal attempt is blocked.

own.name: onOpenChange
own.description: Called whenever the open state changes.

own.name: overlay
own.description: Whether to render the overlay element.

own.name: scrollable
own.description: Whether the dialog content body should be scrollable.

own.name: title
own.description: Primary title displayed in the dialog header.

aria.name: aria-busy
aria.description: Accessibility attribute forwarded by the rendered component.

aria.name: aria-describedby
aria.description: References descriptive text associated with the control.

aria.name: aria-hidden
aria.description: Hides decorative content from assistive technology.

aria.name: aria-label
aria.description: Provides an accessible label when visible text is not sufficient.

aria.name: aria-labelledby
aria.description: References the element that labels the control or region.

aria.name: aria-modal
aria.description: Identifies modal content that traps interaction outside the dialog.

aria.name: role
aria.description: Defines the semantic role exposed to assistive technology.

data.name: data-loading
data.description: Present when the component is loading.

data.name: data-slot
data.description: Identifies the rendered slot for styling hooks and selectors.

ariaAttributes.description: Provides an accessible label when visible text is not sufficient.
